data_objects.name: country_happiness_records
data_objects.meaning: Country-level happiness rankings and scores with regional labels, score uncertainty, and named component measures.

variables.name: Country
variables.meaning: Country name associated with the record.

variables.name: Region
variables.meaning: Broad geographic region assigned to the country.

variables.name: Happiness Rank
variables.meaning: Ordinal rank based on the reported happiness score.

variables.name: Standard Error
variables.meaning: Standard error associated with the happiness score.

variables.name: Economy (GDP per Capita)
variables.meaning: Economy-related component labeled GDP per capita.

variables.name: Family
variables.meaning: Family-related component of the reported happiness record.

variables.name: Freedom
variables.meaning: Freedom-related component of the reported happiness record.

variables.name: Generosity
variables.meaning: Generosity-related component of the reported happiness record.

structure.description: Each row represents one country, with Country as the geographic identifier, Region as a grouping, and rank, score, uncertainty, and component fields stored in wide form.

uncertainties: The reference year or survey period is absent from the table.
The scoring methodology, component scaling, and whether component values are levels or contributions are not documented.
annotation_notes: Component meanings remain close to their source labels because no methodology is included.
